title: ItemOverlayState
description: Simpler state textures based on data-driven approaches.
body:
Generally speaking, only developers can handle the textures of items in different states. However, this library provides a data-driven way to manage them.

User Docs：
- Usage: https://xiao-jin-mod-wiki.netlify.app/mod/itemoverlaystate/usage/
- Predicate：https://xiao-jin-mod-wiki.netlify.app/mod/itemoverlaystate/predicate/

For Modder：
- API: https://xiao-jin-mod-wiki.netlify.app/mod/itemoverlaystate/api/
